name: stand-up-a-teammate
description: The one way a new teammate begins, from anyone's Claude Code (Omero 2026-10-28: "When someone stands someone up, it should be the skill that's used and the process begins"): the person's own words go to Titus on the J Flores server, where the teammate is formed and lives. Never built on a laptop; a teammate already built on one is brought home.
